Toyota signage at the New York International Auto Show in New York City on April 2, 2026. Japan's Toyota Motor on Friday reported a 49% on-year decline in its fourth quarter operating profit ended March, weighed by the impact of U.S. tariffs. results.title: EV Penetration Continues to Grow Down Under — April Update - CleanTechnica
results.content: In April 2026, 25,087 plugin vehicles were sold into the Australian market, out of 94,049 total vehicle sales. This represents almost 27% of the market. The overall market is down. The months of May and June should bring higher numbers of BEVs and PHEVs ordered at the start of the US war on Iran. What is becoming clear is the identities of vehicles that are not selling in Australia. The buying public is turning its back on diesel (down almost 21.7% year on year) and petrol (down 30% year on year). Taking the grandchildren to school, we heard it on the radio: There has been a sharp decline in diesel ute sales. The Toyota RAV4 hybrid is the highest selling car, and Toyota the highest selling auto brand, but BYD is just behind Toyota at #2. This year is showing steady progress in electric vehicle penetration of the Australian market. 1. BYD Sealion 7 — 1,780 sales | year to date 6,248.
